    24	12. Underground Duchy D
    25	12.1 Overview
    26	The Underground Duchy wants to show the foreign 
    27	creatures of the Woodland that they would be better 
    28	off as subjects. As they set up frontier outposts to show 
    29	their power in the Woodland, the Duchy can sway min­
    30	isters to the cause, scoring victory points and diverting 
    31	more of the Duchy’s resources. But be careful—a rever­
    32	sal of fortune could spell public humiliation, leading 
    33	ministers to abandon the task.
    34	12.2 Faction Rules and Abilities
    35	12.2.1     Crafting. The Duchy crafts during Evening by ac­
    36	tivating citadels and markets. 
    37	12.2.2     The Burrow. The Burrow is an unsuited clear­
    38	ing adjacent to each clearing with a tunnel token. 
    39	Non-Duchy pieces cannot be placed in or moved 
    40	into the Burrow. The Duchy always rules the Bur­
    41	row (even with no pieces there).
    42	12.2.3     The Price of Failure. Whenever any number of 
    43	Duchy buildings are removed, the Duchy returns 
    44	their swayed minister card of highest rank (lord, 
    45	then noble, then squire) to their Unswayed Minis­
    46	ters pile, and removes its crown from the game 
    47	permanently, then discards a random card. If they 
    48	have multiple swayed ministers of highest rank, 
    49	the Duchy chooses which to return.
    50	12.2.4     Tunnels. The Duchy has three tunnel tokens. If 
    51	the Duchy is prompted to place a tunnel but all 
    52	three tunnels are on the map, the Duchy may first 
    53	remove any tunnel from the map.
    54	11.4 Birdsong
    55	Your Birdsong has three steps in the following order.
    56	11.4.1     Protectionism. If the Payments box is empty, 
    57	place two warriors in it. 
    58	11.4.2     Score Dividends. If there are any trade posts on 
    59	the map, score one victory point per two funds. 
    60	(Do not score for warriors in Payments or Committed.) 
    61	11.4.3     Gather Funds. Move all warriors on your faction 
    62	board to the Funds box. 
    63	11.5 Daylight
    64	You can commit and spend funds to take actions, as 
    65	follows, in any order and number. When you commit a 
    66	fund, move the warrior to the Committed box. When you 
    67	spend a fund, return the warrior to its owner’s supply.
    68	11.5.1     Move. Commit one fund to take a move.
    69	11.5.2     Battle. Commit one fund to initiate a battle. 
    70	11.5.3     Craft. Commit funds to craft a card from your 
    71	hand. Instead of moving these warriors to the 
    72	Committed box, you must place them on emp­
    73	ty spaces of the Trade Posts tracks matching the 
    74	suits listed on the crafting cost.
    75	I     Export. You may ignore the listed benefit of 
    76	crafting a card, discarding it, to place one Riv­
    77	erfolk warrior in the Payments box.

    89	The Corvid Conspiracy seeks to strong-arm the Wood­

    94	Corvids risk exposure. To avoid this, they must recruit

    96	and extortion.
